section.p: Consider an industrial router specifications .md file that contains a reference table describing hardware and software characteristics. One of the table cells includes a note that provides additional information about a specific specification.

entry.codeblock:
# Router Specifications The following table describes the specifications of the XR5000 Industrial Router. | Specification | Value | Description | |---------------|-------|-------------| | Ethernet Ports | 4 x Gigabit Ethernet | LAN/WAN connectivity ports. | | VPN Tunnels | 100 | Maximum number of concurrent VPN tunnels. | | Operating Temperature | -40°C to 75°C | > [!NOTE]
Full VPN performance is guaranteed only up to 60°C ambient temperature. | | Power Input | 12–48 VDC | Supported input voltage range. |

Router Specifications

The following table describes the specifications of the XR5000 Industrial Router.

Router Specifications Specification Value Description Ethernet Ports 4 x Gigabit Ethernet LAN/WAN connectivity ports. VPN Tunnels 100 Maximum number of concurrent VPN tunnels. Operating Temperature -40°C to 75°C Full VPN performance is guaranteed only up to 60°C ambient temperature. Power Input 12–48 VDC Supported input voltage range.

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the note within the corresponding table cell and generates a DITA <note> element inside the associated table entry. Because the content consists of product specifications intended for reference, the Markdown file is converted into a DITA reference topic containing a structured table. The note remains associated with the specific specification to which it applies.
